Spartz & Comer Call for Oversight Hearing on Ukraine Aid | Representative Victoria Spartz https://t.co/BPHM1K60j8

Oversight is key function of Congress, which we need to exercise much better. Only a small % of aid to Ukraine is direct military aid, which is crucial for stopping this crisis. Congress needs more transparency and better answers to the American people. 
https://t.co/CEhrm8Sz1a

Atrocities of the Putin’s war in Ukraine & treatment of POWs by Russians are barbaric - and what they are doing to the defenders of Azovstal is inhumane.
Intl community cannot continue to be silent.

I joined @Newsmax last night to discuss it with @greta

https://t.co/vjCj4n9dVa

Latest example of the Congress’s failure to exercise its oversight responsibility: 

from the 27 individual audits of the Department of Defense auditors disclaimed its opinion in 17 - which means that financials were so bad that they could not be audited.

https://t.co/xZD7R2SA8V

The issue of “dishonest billing” is not just an issue contributing to our national debt, but also Medicare insolvency, which is looming within next 5 years. If politicians on both sides claim to care about seniors they have to stop this fraud and abuse. 

https://t.co/74cVRw4LAZ

This intentional over-billing of Medicare by large hospital monopolies building Taj Mahals, paying multi-million dollar salaries to executives and investing billions on Wall Street needs to stop if we want to save Medicare for seniors. https://t.co/vwpglm28bj
Congress should exercise better accountability and oversight of the executive branch, as I’ve called for many times. https://t.co/575aiOaRq3

Great meeting with @AFPhq and @IndianaAFP this week!

Appreciate their work on improving health care value & leading a letter of over 20 ideologically diverse think tanks to support site-neutral payments & stop overbilling of Medicare by large hospitals.

https://t.co/TG1k6QwiWO https://t.co/2ZHcRdiHZX

Today, the House passed the “Lower Costs, More Transparency Act” to move the needle on billing transparency to stop overbilling of Medicare by monopolies and price transparency to improve value for patients. https://t.co/IZIpgW6ePW

This morning, I noticed that large hospital monopolies already started attack ads to protect their large Wall Street investments, executive salaries and lack of competition for value at the expense of taxpayers and patients. 

I hope the American people will see through it! https://t.co/IYzoR1ydYT

The issue of overbilling the federal government, state governments, and patients by large health care oligopolies is astronomical. 

Congress and statehouses around the country must grow a backbone to get it under control before we are all bankrupt.

https://t.co/2RV9Xe3rnh

A funny way @billmaher discusses a serious issue, which is unfortunately true. Viewer discretion is advised. 

https://t.co/be9KsDmH3l

Big hospitals, big insurance, PBMs, numerous intermediaries and big pharma oligopolies have been destructive for healthcare value and fiscal state of our nation.

“…the number of hospital administrators has soared over 3800%.”

“There are over 10 administrators for every doctor.”

“…competition lacking, quality is diminished.”

A DOGE Approach Is needed in Healthcare Beginning with Hospitals https://t.co/9qp9F40YaA

Is Senator @maziehirono talking about greedy rich CEOs of nonprofit (very profitable tax-exempt) hospitals? 

You can check out their salaries here:
https://t.co/jCmsUws82U

While many people on Medicaid, especially the most vulnerable like people with disabilities, are losing benefits, many hospitals are profiteering off their backs. 

“… the state and the … CMS decided to reimburse hospitals for their Medicaid services at the commercial payment rates. Most of the funding comes from federal taxpayers.” “… more than twice what Medicare would pay.”

“Federal taxpayers are having their dollars funneled by the federal and state governments to hospitals … encouraging high commercial prices that hurt workers and employers in the state.”

https://t.co/gg2Os12a7Z

What is Congress thinking?!?

“the country's fiscal health deteriorated further since Moody's lowered its outlook on the U.S. triple-A rating”

“Debt affordability will worsen at a faster rate, with interest payments accounting for 30% of revenue by 2035”

https://t.co/pRFanv5GdX
The $600 Billion Medicaid Maneuver on the Chopping Block - WSJ https://t.co/2XTvhJkHmK

Democrat hypocrisy: “It’s a scam, Biden agreed. The states were gaming the system, taxing doctors and hospitals so they could get federal reimbursements and then returning the money to the providers. Let’s call it like it is, and let’s just do this.”

https://t.co/dMogz8U29R

Today, Rep. Spartz reintroduced a comprehensive health care package to combat hospital monopolies, increase transparency, and address waste, fraud, and abuse. 

See full release below:

“We Have Two Choices – Fix Health Care Now or Bankrupt Our Country”https://t.co/aidCgq8e7c

I don’t agree with @washingtonpost often but have to agree on Medicare - 

Medicare Advantage is full of fraud, as well as regular Medicare with hospitals over-billing for services & drugs, & cooking the books to book fake losses for charity care costing us hundreds of billions.
Great connecting with @ZotecPartners, a key health stakeholder in #IN05, to discuss improving healthcare access, lowering costs, and delivering better value for patients. https://t.co/u44zwqT316

Today, Rep. Spartz introduced the SMART Health Care Act (Stopping Medicare Abuses to Restore Trust in Health Care Act), which will save Medicare hundreds of billions of dollars and help to improve health care price, quality, access, competition and value. https://t.co/JPc6rPIHov

https://t.co/1kqGWBrxcu 
Medicaid payment programs have often pushed payment rates ABOVE Medicare rates and up to commercial rates based on the CMS rule promulgated by the Biden Administration. 

The most vulnerable Medicaid recepients have been losing benefits while health care oligopolies are milking the federal government. It has to stop!
